# Scenario: Fed Aggressive Tightening / Hard Landing

## Trigger
- Core PCE re-accelerates above 3.5%
- Wage growth accelerates above 5%
- Fed forced to hike rates further or hold higher for longer
- Market pricing shifts from "cuts soon" to "higher for longer"

## Macro Assumptions

| Variable | Baseline | 6-Month | 12-Month |
|----------|---------|---------|----------|
| Fed Funds Rate | X.XX% | +50bp | +100bp |
| 10Y Yield | X.XX% | +30bp | +50bp |
| USD (DXY) | XXX | +5% | +8% |
| GDP Growth | X.X% | -1pp | -2pp |
| Unemployment | X.X% | +0.5pp | +1.5pp |
| Core PCE | X.X% | +0.3pp | -0.5pp (demand destruction) |

## Transmission Channels

### Rate Channel
- Growth stocks (duration 15-25Y): -15% to -30%
- REITs: -10% to -20%
- IG bonds: -5% to -10%
- Banks: +5% to +10% (NIM expansion, but watch credit quality)

### FX Channel
- Strong USD: -3% to -5% on S&P 500 EPS (translation)
- EM currencies sell off: -10% to -20% in some cases
- Commodities priced in USD headwind

### Commodity Channel
- Oil: Demand destruction → -10% to -20%
- Industrial metals: Growth scare → -10% to -15%
- Gold: Real rates headwind → -5% to -10%

### Liquidity Channel
- Net liquidity contracts rapidly
- Risk appetite collapse — crypto, EM, HY hit hardest
- Flight to quality: USD, Treasuries (front-end), gold miners

## Sector Impact Matrix

| Sector | Impact | Driver |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Tech / Growth | 🔴 -20 to -30% | Duration + risk appetite |
| Real Estate | 🔴 -10 to -20% | Rates + recession risk |
| Banks | 🟡 -5 to +5% | NIM up, credit quality down |
| Energy | 🔴 -10 to -20% | Demand destruction |
| Staples | 🟢 -5 to 0% | Defensive rotation |
| Gold Miners | 🟡 -5 to +5% | Gold down, but relative safe haven |
| Crypto | 🔴 -30 to -50% | Most liquidity-sensitive |

## Key Monitoring Triggers
- [ ] Core PCE 3-month annualized > 3.5%
- [ ] Average hourly earnings > 5% YoY
- [ ] Fed rhetoric shift from "patient" to "vigilant"
- [ ] Market pricing > 50bp of additional hikes
- [ ] Initial claims rising above 280K (demand destruction taking hold)
